glossary.definition: (A) "Public agency" means any governmental corporation, unit, organization, instrumentality, or officer authorized by law to appropriate property in the courts of this state.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 163.01 to 163.22 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Private agency" means any corporation, firm, partnership, voluntary association, joint-stock association, or company that is not a public agency and that is authorized by law to appropriate property in the courts of this state.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 163.01 to 163.22 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (C) "Agency" means any public agency or private agency.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 163.01 to 163.22 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (D) "Court" means the court of common pleas or the probate court of any county in which the property sought to be appropriated is located in whole or in part.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 163.01 to 163.22 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (E) "Owner" means any individual, partnership, association, or corporation having any estate, title, or interest in any real property sought to be appropriated.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 163.01 to 163.22 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (F) "Real property," "land," or "property" includes any estate, title, or interest in any real property that is authorized to be appropriated by the agency in question, unless the context otherwise requires.

glossary.definition: (G) "Public utility" has the same meaning as in section 4905.02 of the Revised Code and also includes a public utility owned or operated by one or more municipal corporations, an electric cooperative, and an agency holding a certificate of public convenience and necessity granted by the federal energy regulatory commission.

As used in sections 163.01 to 163.22 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (I) "Electric cooperative" has the same meaning as in section 4928.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 163.01 to 163.22 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (J) "Good faith offer" means the written offer that an agency that is appropriating property must make to the owner of the property pursuant to division (B) of section 163.04 of the Revised Code before commencing an appropriation proceeding.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 163.01 to 163.22 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (K) "Goodwill" means the calculable benefits that accrue to a business as a result of its location, reputation for dependability, skill or quality, and any other circumstances that result in probable retention of old, or acquisition of new, patronage.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 163.01 to 163.22 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (L) "Municipal power agency" has the same meaning as in section 3734.058 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 163.01 to 163.22 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (M) "Port authority transportation facility" means any facility developed, controlled, or operated by a port authority for the purpose of providing passenger, cargo, or freight transportation services, such as airports, maritime ports, rail facilities, transit facilities, and support facilities directly related to any airport, maritime port, rail facility, or transit facility.
